issues: The eyes are white 2x2 square plates with a small off-centre black dot, so they read as goggles. They need round white eyes with centred black pupils.
The beak sits between the eyes instead of below them, and it is a small square block. It should sit low on the face, just above the white chest, and stick out further.
The feet are thin 1x2 orange plates that barely show. The concept has big, wide orange feet that stick out in front of the belly.
The flippers hug the sides and are short, so they are hard to see from the front. The concept flippers are long, hang down past mid-belly and splay out a little.
The black hood should come down lower over the top of the white chest, so the white area reads as an egg-shaped belly rather than a rectangle.
distilled: A chunky, upright penguin with a black back and head, a big white belly, a bright orange beak and two flat orange feet. Short black flippers are attached at the sides, and the whole model stands on its own feet in a calm, symmetrical pose.
